default.description: The floating surfaces fit their content and close themselves: the panel and the HUD resize to what they drew, and every surface hides itself — the panel after a switch, the HUD on its dwell, the sheets on Esc. hide and set-size are the window permissions beyond the default set; measured live, without allow-hide the panel stayed up after every switch and the HUD's dwell never hid it — the person read that as «висит вечно». The undecorated sheets and onboarding still drag themselves (start-dragging; the panel and HUD never do), and the panel's blur-dismiss listens for focus events — core:event:default — without which the webview never saw the focus change measured live as «скрывается только при клике на иконку».
